<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy shift:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India hiked the repo rate to 5.50% and shifted to a &quot;calibrated tightening&quot; stance, projecting 7.1% GDP growth despite persistent inflation risks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPOUVfOG95VEFzUW9SSldGMmd3T1E4UVFmbF9OSFJCcEN3Q1ZjNzU2WWh4RERxRFdabUFuaV9ydW1IVXJNMmd6RHNxcHhDdlhMbUxTZUJxbWc1MlZHYTRpVzFpT0xVZFl5d1lNeTFCYmhMdFJLc0tISm9nSEFYYXAtYk1aaHFXV1Q2RGNheFMzd3owRmtndEt2UmV4SDY?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>External pressures:</strong> Markets remain sensitive to global headwinds, specifically crude oil prices hovering near $103 and the narrow India-US bond yield spread, which remains near a 22-year low.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency stability:</strong> The Indian Rupee has found some relief from a pullback in US bond yields, with RBI intervention helping to limit volatility against the dollar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE1rNFZfMkNQeWxweDBEb1JlVU84R1k1RlJOdklfNVpDaThTYWo3M2YzQlk1MDhWbjFaMjlvOUgyNnNFWVlUYkl2SkN0OUVKRjdVZTJj?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxON3JrMHhkWWV2VkZNSHl0ZElrWHllQlBfZFBqYU8yelcxOGpZbHpqaW1CZ2lmbVBranlsM3JXNnpDNjVwNVVzQVNHMEdYOTlGOU1VNXd1dkpRSkNVNWFGbXpvRGlyaXFiM0ZkdzU2RG40SU9QUkJuTGJ4dkNhcGJpMXA0MXZZeHgyYUJBcmI5a2ktVlBDLTJOV0o3WklOY0F0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
